
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- 05_complex_all_features.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 05_complex_all_features.volt:8[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]7 |[/dim]     pin motor: PWM = 4
 [dim]8 |[/dim]     pin fan: Output = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 05_complex_all_features.volt:9[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 15 controls boot log output. If pulled LOW, boot messages are suppressed (usually harmless).

 [dim]8 |[/dim]     pin fan: Output = 5
 [dim]9 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = 15
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- 05_complex_all_features.volt:20[/yellow bold]

Variable `motor_isr_count` is shared between pid_control (critical) and health_report. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]19 |[/dim] var total_syncs: int = 0
 [dim]20 |[/dim] var motor_isr_count: int = 0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]
